categories.main_business_segments: Zhanjiang Guolian Aquatic Products Co., Ltd. primarily operates in aquatic food processing, focusing on deep-processed and pre-prepared aquatic food products. The company also engages in initial processing and global seafood selection, including products like shrimp, fish, crayfish, bullfrogs, and related pre-prepared dishes. It has subsidiaries involved in aquatic product sales, feed production, and aquatic seedling breeding.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced food processing technologies including automated production lines, electronic supervision systems ('2211' electronic monitoring), and holds multiple international certifications such as HACCP, BRC, and BAP. It emphasizes R&D in pre-prepared dishes with standardized production processes and has developed a systematic product development system with experienced culinary and R&D teams.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large-scale restaurant chains, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and end consumers in both domestic and international markets. The company serves B2B clients such as restaurant heavy users and industrial clients, as well as B2C channels through direct e-commerce sales on platforms like JD.com, Tmall, and Pinduoduo. Major clients include large retail chains and food service companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, accounting for about 68.54% of revenue, and internationally across the Americas, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets, which contribute approximately 31.46% of revenue. It has established global procurement and sales networks covering China, South America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhanjiang Guolian operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aquatic food supply chain, focusing on procurement of raw aquatic products globally, deep processing, product development, and sales. It has divested upstream activities such as feed production and seedling breeding to concentrate on food processing and marketing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes upgrading its business model around pre-prepared dishes, focusing on core products with high market share and profitability. It invests significantly in R&D to develop new pre-prepared aquatic food products and improve production processes. The R&D efforts target product diversification, quality enhancement, and innovation in pre-prepared dishes like shrimp balls, fish slices, and crayfish products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of aquatic food products, including pre-prepared dishes, initial processed seafood, and selected global seafood. Sales channels include direct sales to restaurants, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and distributors. The company also earns income from related services such as food safety assurance and product development support for large clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading aquatic food enterprise in China, recognized as the largest listed aquatic company and the largest shrimp processing and sales enterprise in the country. It holds a strong competitive position with international certifications and a comprehensive global supply chain. Competitors include other major aquatic food processors and pre-prepared food producers in China and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 3.41 billion, a 26.16% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 742 million. Despite the downturn, the company maintains significant asset scale with total assets over RMB 4.1 billion and continues to invest in R&D and market expansion. The company faces challenges from market price declines and trade tariffs but is focused on operational efficiency and strategic product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhanjiang Guolian emphasizes its global procurement capabilities, stringent food safety controls, and comprehensive product quality certifications to ensure reliable and high-quality aquatic food products. Its value proposition includes offering a wide range of pre-prepared aquatic dishes tailored for both restaurant chains and household consumers, supported by strong R&D and marketing capabilities. The company differentiates itself through its integrated supply chain, innovative product portfolio, and strong brand presence in both domestic and international markets.
